stories.headline: US grounds all flights after air traffic 'communication issue'
body: The US grounded flights nationwide after a communication problem hit air traffic control centres.
About 7,000 flights were delayed or cancelled, FlightAware said.
The FAA is investigating.
stories.vc: Repeated air traffic failures cost airlines millions and add pressure to fix the ageing system.

stories.headline: Turkiye and Qatar sign a mutual defence pact
body: Turkiye and Qatar signed a mutual defence agreement after Erdogan met Qatar's emir in Istanbul.
Erdogan said they would work to stop war returning to the Gulf.
Qatar's emir called it a strategic partnership.
stories.vc: Closer Gulf security ties could steady a region vital for India's energy and remittances.

stories.headline: Europe picks five countries for the next Ukraine peace talks
body: Europe will send EU officials and five countries to the next round of Ukraine talks.
They are the UK, France, Germany, Italy and Poland.
European leaders fear Moscow and Washington could decide the war's outcome without them.
stories.joke: Five seats, one voice. In theory.
stories.vc: Europe's role in talks will shape who pays for Ukraine's rebuilding.

stories.headline: Markets snap 3-day rally on fears of an RBI rate hike
body: The Sensex fell 318 points to 81,592, and the Nifty slipped 0.61% to 25,144.
Investors fear the RBI may raise rates next month after inflation hit 6.09%.
It was the first big fall this month.
stories.vc: A rate hike would raise loan costs for companies and home buyers.

stories.headline: Bengaluru's Razorpay gets SEBI nod for its IPO
body: Fintech Razorpay has SEBI approval for a ₹5,000-6,000 crore IPO, likely between January and March 2027.
It is targeting a valuation of about $5 billion.
That's below the $7.5 billion it was valued at in 2021.
stories.joke: Razorpay is ready to accept payment from the public.
stories.vc: A big fintech listing will test investor appetite after a strong run for startup IPOs.

stories.headline: PM opens Bengaluru's Pink Line as metro passes 100 km
body: PM Modi opened the elevated section of Bengaluru's Pink Line on Friday.
It takes the city's metro network past 100 km.
He said better connectivity creates jobs and fights poverty.
stories.joke: Bengaluru traffic just lost a few thousand customers.
stories.vc: More metro reach lifts property values and cuts commuting costs.

stories.headline: Microsoft's email outage turns into a global cloud crisis
body: A Microsoft outage that began with Outlook and Teams spread to its wider cloud services worldwide.
It also knocked out Copilot and Defender security tools.
Indian firms from startups to multinationals were hit.
stories.joke: Your boss couldn't email you. Enjoy it while it lasts.
stories.vc: Big outages push companies to spread work across more than one cloud provider.

stories.headline: Unhedged: sticky inflation, a tougher Fed, and Nvidia's slump
body: The FT's Unhedged says inflation is stubborn and the US Federal Reserve is talking tough again.
Nvidia shares have fallen more than a third from their October peak.
Bond expert Gregory Peters of PGIM discusses what comes next.
stories.vc: Higher rates for longer would hurt pricey tech stocks the most.

stories.headline: Banned Nvidia chips trained China's top AI models, research claims
body: Leading Chinese open-weight AI models were trained on Nvidia chips banned from export to China, a study claims.
It suggests wide access to Blackwell GPUs among Chinese labs.
The firm linked to Jensen Huang's affair has been implicated in chip smuggling.
stories.vc: Tighter export enforcement could hit Nvidia's sales and China's AI progress.

stories.headline: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation
body: LangChain raised $300 million at a $3 billion valuation, led by CapitalG.
That's more than double its value a year ago.
It now focuses on managing AI agents for companies.
stories.joke: Chains that link AI agents, now worth billions.
stories.vc: Tools to manage AI agents are a hot niche as firms deploy them widely.

stories.headline: ChatGPT's new Wallet lets AI agents shop for you
body: OpenAI launched a wallet that lets ChatGPT's agents choose and buy products for users.
It starts with some US Pro subscribers.
Users approve each purchase with Face ID or a fingerprint.
stories.joke: Your AI now has your card. Choose wisely.
stories.vc: AI checkout could shift online shopping power from stores to AI platforms.

stories.headline: Colette Kress takes over Nvidia amid risky bets and a legal mess
body: Longtime finance chief Colette Kress is now interim CEO of Nvidia after Jensen Huang's exit.
She inherits big AI investments and ongoing investigations.
Experts say Nvidia has acted like a bank backing much of the AI industry.
stories.vc: Kress's choices will shape confidence in the whole AI supply chain.

stories.statLabel: Republican women who pushed Epstein files
stories.headline: Three GOP women pushed to release Epstein files. None will be back in Congress
body: Marjorie Taylor Greene, Nancy Mace and Lauren Boebert pushed to release the Epstein files.
Greene resigned, Mace lost a governor's primary and Boebert lost her seat.
Boebert lost to retired Navy Rear Adm. Eileen Laubacher.
stories.vc: Breaking with party leaders still carries a heavy political cost.

stories.headline: Dr Harleen Kaur to head Government Medical College Doda
body: Jammu & Kashmir has given Professor Harleen Kaur charge of Government Medical College, Doda.
She is a microbiology professor at GMC Jammu.
The college had been without a regular principal for months.
stories.vc: Stable leadership helps new medical colleges keep their approvals and seats.

stories.headline: Manipal opens 300-bed Electronic City hospital; revenue up 37%
body: Manipal Hospitals opened a 300-licensed-bed hospital in Bengaluru's Electronic City.
Its network now has 13,440 licensed beds.
Quarterly revenue rose 37% to ₹3,399 crore, helped by its Sahyadri acquisition.
stories.vc: Big chains adding beds in tech suburbs shows demand following Bengaluru's growth.

stories.headline: Parliament panel to examine strengthening government hospitals
body: Parliament's health committee will review how to strengthen government hospitals.
It will also study affordable cancer care, organ transplants and liver disease.
It picked 12 subjects in all.
stories.vc: Parliamentary reviews can unlock more funding for public hospitals.

stories.headline: Telangana High Court takes up safety gaps in government hospitals
body: The Telangana High Court started its own public interest case on safety and staffing in state hospitals.
It follows a petition flagging systemic shortcomings.
The court says patients' right to life is at stake.
stories.vc: Court pressure often speeds up hiring and safety upgrades in public hospitals.

stories.headline: FIA boss plans to scrap age limits for office holders
body: FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem wants to end the age limit of 75 for the governing body's leaders.
The plan goes to next month's FIA General Assembly.
Critics say it's a step towards him staying president for life.
stories.joke: Term limits gone, age limits next. What's left, the stopwatch?
stories.vc: How the FIA is run affects F1's commercial deals and teams' trust in the rules.
